Inside view:** The confirmed Sept 9 keynote (three new iPhones, foldable hype, major press coverage) will drive a large surge in "iPhone" search volume — historically 2-3x normal raw volume during launch week. Modeling this as a raw-volume multiplier (~2.2x) applied to iPhone's baseline share while holding others' raw volumes near baseline yields: iPhone share jumps to ~58-62%, mechanically compressing all four other shares proportionally (since shares are zero-sum). Samsung, Tesla, Netflix, Disney each lose roughly 30-35% of their prior share due to this dilution, with Disney's independent upward drift partly offsetting its compression.

**3. Pre-mortem:** Most likely failure mode: I overestimate the iPhone surge magnitude (real launches sometimes show more muted Trends spikes than expected, or interest concentrates on the specific day rather than the whole week average) — or underestimate it (foldable iPhone hype could push even higher). This justifies a wide sd on iPhone and correspondingly wider sd on the squeezed categories.

**4. Calibration:** Historical weekly sd is small (~0.6-1.6), but this week is a known outlier event with high magnitude uncertainty, so sd must be several multiples of the historical baseline, especially for iPhone.
